cards.name: hero
cards.question: Roblox Username Checker
cards.qualifier: Check a Roblox username against Roblox's format rules, get close valid alternatives, and open Roblox's user search to see whether someone already has it.

cards.name: what-the-roblox-username
cards.title: What the Roblox username checker does

groups.label: The rules it tests
groups.text: Length between 3 and 20 characters Only letters and numbers.

groups.label: What the search button shows
groups.text: Roblox doesn't have a profile address built from the username.

groups.label: Nothing is sent anywhere
groups.text: The check runs in your browser.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to check a Roblox username

steps.title: Type the name you want
steps.text: Enter it the way you want it to look.

steps.title: Search Roblox for an exact match
steps.text: Tap the button to open Roblox's user search.

cards.name: username-vs-display-name
cards.title: Username vs. display name on Roblox

groups.label: Your username is unique
groups.text: Your username is the name tied to your account, shown with an @ in front.

groups.label: Roblox's filter has a say too
groups.text: Roblox also blocks names its filter considers inappropriate.

cards.name: stay-safe-when-picking
cards.title: Stay safe when picking a Roblox username

groups.label: Keep personal details out of it
groups.text: Your username is public, so leave out your real name.

groups.label: Use the same safe name elsewhere
groups.text: If you also post Roblox clips on YouTube or TikTok.
